item.name: Orb of Corrosion

effects.title: Corrosion
effects.text: Your attacks reduce the target's armor by -2, slows their movement by -16% (-8% against melee targets), and reduces Health Restoration by 18%. Lasts for 3 seconds.

notes: Armor reduction does not stack with its components, Desolator, or Stygian Desolator.
item.lore: Seepage from the wounds of a warrior deity, sealed in an arcanist's orb following a campaign of vicious slaughter.
